associations.rationale: The displayed type places Der(A) in the linear endomorphisms as a Lie subalgebra, but its elided body does not state the defining Leibniz membership condition.
The formal type derives the Leibniz identity from membership in Der(A), so it gives only the consequence direction rather than characterizing which endomorphisms belong to Der(A).
This merely gives the type of the IsLeibniz predicate without displaying its defining law.
The iff directly characterizes membership in Der(A) by the Leibniz formula for all a and b.
